name: database-migration
description: Schema/data migration pattern with rollback thinking and mandatory approval.

stages.title: Plan forward/backward compatibility and rollback
stages.instruction: Plan schema/data migration, compatibility window, backfill, locking/downtime risks, rollback/roll-forward strategy, and observability before implementation.

stages.title: Implement bounded change
stages.instruction: Implement only the requested bounded change. Inspect the repository first; preserve unrelated changes.
